messages:
support_erin: Customer ACME opened an escalation — their consumer JSON.parse is failing after our recent model promotion. They say structured output returned a stringified payload instead of an object. Ticket ACME-12345. Posting samples below.

customer_acme: Repro from our webhook consumer. JSON.parse errors with 'Unexpected token \" in JSON at position 11'. Full response we received: 

```
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "result": "{\\\"order_id\\\": 9876, \\\"items\\\":[{\\\"sku\\\":\\\"X1\\\",\\\"qty\\\":1}], \\\"status\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}",
  "served_by": "redwood-llama-4b-v3",
  "meta": {"request_id": "r-abc"}
}
```

We expect "result" to be an object, not a string. This started happening after you promoted redwood-llama-4b to v3 tonight.

support_erin: Which endpoint / params did you call? Can you share the exact request and the model header?

customer_acme: We call POST /v1/generate with model=redwood-llama-4b and we set header `X-Model-Version: v3`. Body (sanitized): 

```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"prompt":"{\"order\": {\"id\": 9876}}","mode":"json","max_tokens":64}'
```

We do not use streaming. Request id r-abc was in the response meta.

eng_oncall_jon: Thanks. Two quick asks: can you paste the exact response headers (content-type, content-length, transfer-encoding) for r-abc? Also did you receive this as a single full response or chunked/streamed pieces?

customer_acme: Content-Type was application/json; Content-Length: 512; no Transfer-Encoding. Single full response.

ml_engineer_maya: I'm seeing related traces in the canary logs — the v3 generation path added an extra JSON-escaping step when the structured-output detector flagged the payload as 'raw string'. It looks like the runtime wrapped the structured payload into a quoted string to preserve inner quotes, but we should've unwrapped before returning. This would produce exactly the `\"{...}\"` behaviour.

Suggested immediate workarounds: 1) pin to redwood-llama-4b@v2 (exact versioned spec) — that avoids v3. 2) if you need v3, as a stopgap have the consumer detect a stringified JSON and run JSON.parse on that field. Not ideal but quick.

infra_bot: canary-swap-bot: promoted redwood-llama-4b -> v3 at 2026-03-17T13:02:10Z (commit abcdef123).

support_erin: Customer pinned to v2 locally and confirms their consumer now parses OK. Can we prioritize a rollback/patch? Customer is blocked in production.

ml_engineer_maya: I'll open INF-4521 for a serving-runtime hotfix to remove the extra stringify wrapper in structured-output mode and add a safe_unwrap check. Assigning to runtime team. ETA ~24-48h to QA and roll. Will also add a regression test for structured-output webhooks.

eng_oncall_jon: I'll add a temporary smoke test to the canary promotion pipeline to validate structured-output payloads against a sample webhook consumer — filing INF-4522.

customer_acme: Thanks — please ping when patch is deployed. Can you also share guidance on how to validate structured-output compatibility before future promotions?

support_erin: We'll follow up with a postmortem and add a pre-promotion e2e check. For now pinning to v2 is the recommended mitigation.

customer_acme: :thumbsup: thanks for the quick help.
